title: presto: Efficient, Training-free, and Open-world Object Placement via Imaginary Search
abstract: arXiv:2608.21543v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Object placement is critical in image composition, requiring spatially and semantically coherent positioning of objects within diverse scenes. Existing approaches typically rely on hand-crafted rules or supervised learning on limited datasets, which restricts their generalization and interpretability, especially in open-world scenarios involving novel objects and scenes. In this work, we reformulate open-world object placement as a heuristic search task guided by reasoning from a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM). We introduce \textsf{presto}, a zero-shot, training-free framework that operates within an imaginary action space to iteratively refine object position and scale. Our coarse-to-fine search strategy ensures fast convergence, and we evaluate two decision-making variants: Metric-guided Selection and MLLM-as-a-judge. translated_title: presto：通过想象搜索实现高效、无需训练的开源对象放置
translated_abstract: 对象放置在图像合成中至关重要，要求在不同场景中实现空间和语义上协调一致的对象定位。现有方法通常依赖手工规则或在有限数据集上的监督学习，这限制了其泛化能力和可解释性，尤其是在涉及新对象和新场景的开源场景中。在这项工作中，我们将开源对象放置重新定义为一种由多模态大语言模型（MLLM）推理引导的启发式搜索任务。我们引入了\textsf{presto}，一个零样本、无需训练的框架，它在想象动作空间中操作，以迭代优化对象的位置和尺度。我们的从粗到细的搜索策略确保了快速收敛，并评估了两种决策变体：度量引导选择和MLLM作为评判者。在多个基准上的实验表明，\textsf{presto}实现了最先进的性能，尤其在...
tldr: 提出了一种基于多模态大语言模型推理的零样本、无需训练的对象放置框架，通过想象搜索实现开源场景下的高效和精确放置。
en_tdlr: Proposes a zero-shot, training-free object placement framework guided by multimodal LLM reasoning, achieving efficient and precise placement in open-world scenes via imaginary search.
